en.text:
Holding [Reload] within 4 seconds of a kill consumes 4 ammo, <title refills [G_refill] /> the magazine, and grants 'The Rock'.

The Rock replaces your grenade ability with a tossed <kinetic/>Kinetic grenade that explodes for <pve 2072 /> <pvp [181] /> damage in a 9 meter radius, dealing 20% damage at the edge of its radius. Detonates 0.6 seconds after it slows down enough.

The Rock counts as a grenade ability and is buffed by, and triggers, grenade-associated effects.
